provenance: Synthetic: a small feature with hidden edge cases (extra whitespace, empty input). Authored for this harness.

task.name: Add a titleCase helper
task.description: Add `titleCase(text)` in `src/title-case.mjs` as a named export and re-export it from `src/index.mjs`. It uppercases the first letter of every whitespace-separated word and lowercases the rest, joins the words with a single space, and trims the ends. The empty string stays empty.
